about.text:
Jacob Kouthoofd Mårtensson is an industrial designer exploring how small, creative solutions can spark meaningful impact. With a background in Art Direction and a Master’s in Product Design from ECAL, this intersection allows him to craft iconic silhouettes, iterate quickly, communicate ideas clearly, and embrace the creative freedom to abandon what doesn’t work.

He has contributed to projects with studios such as Form Us With Love, Pentagram London, and SIMMER, for clients including Volvo, H&M, IKEA, and Disney.
